main.description: The public announcement of a poll, authored by the org's DID. Publishes the question, options, ballot rules, and the per-poll issuer pubkey BEFORE the poll opens (the pre-open publication rule of the E2E-V scheme). The eligibility roster, delegation, resolved weights, and token issuance stay private in the org store and are never records. Lifecycle is a monotonic state field on this one record (announced, open, closed) rather than a separate close record: a close record would split one poll across two records every verifier must join and would need its own authority rule, while a single record makes each state transition a firehose-visible update event. Only state may change after creation; any other mutation is tamper-evident via the record's update history and voids the poll. Only closingAuthority may move state to closed.

options.description: The choices, in ballot order. When blank is true the LAST element is the trailing Blank abstention (excluded from winning).

state.description: Lifecycle state, monotonic: announced, then open, then closed. Ballots verify only against entries cast while open.

closingAuthority.description: The org DID that may close the poll (move state to closed).

issuerPubkey.description: PROVISIONAL encoding pending the ballot-spec crate's pinned serialization: the poll's RSA issuer public key as base64url (unpadded) DER SPKI. Per-poll keys are the cryptographic poll binding (RFC 9474 blinding hides the message from the issuer); required at creation so publication strictly precedes open.

minVote.description: Minimum selections for a non-blank ballot. A lone blank abstention bypasses this minimum.

blank.description: Whether the last element of options is the trailing Blank abstention: valid only alone on a ballot, excluded from winning in the tally.

openAt.description: When the poll opens (state moves to open). Resolved weights are frozen at this instant.

closesAt.description: Optional: the scheduled close. Closure still requires the closingAuthority's state transition.
